description:
List the people at one company, leadership first, a page at a time: the chief executive, then founders, chairs and presidents, the rest of the C-suite, board members, EVPs, SVPs, VPs, directors, managers, and everyone else, the longest-serving first within a level. Each entry gives the person slug and their title at this company, with the total across all pages.

Use it to go past the 25-person preview `particle_company_get` include=people returns, or to narrow a large company with `role` (e.g. executive), `title` (e.g. 'chief', 'investor relations') or `name` (e.g. 'huang'). For one company's profile and its leadership at a glance, call `particle_company_get` instead. To find a person by name, use `particle_person_resolve`.

Person slugs feed `particle_person_get`, `particle_person_get_statement_characteristics`, and the `person_slug` filter of `particle_podcast_find_mentions`, `particle_podcast_search_transcripts` and `particle_podcast_list_episodes`. For how the company's people speak on podcasts together, use `particle_company_get_statement_characteristics`.

company_slug.description: Company identifier — slug (e.g. 'nvidia'), domain (e.g. 'nvidia.com'), or canonical ID, as particle_company_get takes.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's cursor field. Pass the same filters and sort with it.

include_past.description: Also list people who held a role here and no longer do, marked (former), after everyone current. Default false.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring of the person's name (e.g. 'huang'), to find someone at a large company. To find a person by name across every company, use particle_person_resolve.

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

role.description: Only people whose title falls in this role class. executive is the leadership class: founders, chairs, presidents, VPs, directors and heads whose title names none of the other classes' functions, plus every officer (any Chief ... Officer or President) whatever function the title names. So a Chief Marketing Officer is kept but a VP of Marketing is marketing. marketing, brand, partnerships, media_advertising, communications and growth are the functions a sponsorship pitch would reach; other is a title matching none.

sort.description: seniority (default): leadership first, the longest-serving first within a level. recent: the most recently started first.

title.description: Case-insensitive substring of the title at this company (e.g. 'chief', 'founder', 'investor relations').

name: particle_company_list_people
title: Particle Company List People
